desc:
The EKRON 5.56 suppressor is a precision-engineered, 3D-printed titanium solution designed for optimal suppression with minimal back pressure. Weighing just 8.5 oz, it delivers exceptional durability and performance for both semi-automatic and full-automatic rifles.

Its patent-pending gas flow system enhances firearm function while reducing wear, making it ideal for demanding use. The EKRON is full-auto rated when used with a 3-port muzzle brake and installed on barrels 10.3” or longer. While optimized for 5.56/.223, the Ekron is capable of 6MM PRC and 6MM Creedmoor. Finished in Cerakote for durability and easy to maintain with ultrasonic cleaning, the EKRON sets a new standard in lightweight suppressor design.

Large bore options available for bulk orders.
